Federation Nemesis style yard, V1.0

This is a varient design of the Drydock seen at the end of Nemesis, it is NOT meant to be an exact build of it. This will replace the second Federation yard (fyard2) with this one.

0 - Credits

Mesh and textures - Icewolf132

Original Design - Paramount (Star Trek: Nemesis)

And I'd like to thank the Armada II Files staff for the readme template.


1 - Installation


For Armada 2 playersust extract the files in the A2 folder into your Armada 2 directory (Default; C:\Program Files\Activision\Star Trek Armada II), and overwrite if asked.

For Armada 1 players modding experiance will be required.

And here's the GUI_GLOBAL info for those who know what they're doing ;)

UNDER @reference=64

b_fyard3			gbfyard3		0	0	64	64

UNDER @reference=256

fyard3w1			wirefyard3		0	0	48	48		
fyard3w2			wirefyard3		48	0	48	48		
fyard3w3			wirefyard3		96	0	48	48		
fyard3w4			wirefyard3		144	0	48	48		
fyard3w5			wirefyard3		192	0	48	48
